text: I slipped and fell in a shopping centre in Melbourne. Which public liability lawyers are best?

result.keyword: I slipped and fell in a shopping centre in Melbourne. Which public liability lawyers are best?
result.markdown:
Yes. For a **slip-and-fall in a Melbourne shopping centre**, I’d shortlist these firms rather than choosing purely on advertising or Google ratings:

### My shortlist

1. **Law Partners Injury Lawyers Melbourne** — **my first call**
   - Specifically handles **shopping-centre and supermarket slip-and-fall claims in Victoria**.
   - Offers a free initial assessment and no-win-no-fee arrangements.
   - Their published page says they have a **4.9/5 Google rating** and specialise in personal injury. [lawpartners.com.au](https://lawpartners.com.au/vic/public-liability-lawyers/supermarket-injury?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
   - Melbourne office: Level 14, 114 William St.

2. **Slater and Gordon Lawyers** — **best for a large, established practice**
   - Their Melbourne public-liability team expressly deals with people who **slip and fall at shopping centres or supermarkets**.
   - They offer an obligation-free initial appointment and no-win-no-fee arrangements. [www.slatergordon.com.au](https://www.slatergordon.com.au/personal-injury/public-liability/public-liability-lawyers-in-melbourne?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
   - Particularly attractive if the injury is substantial or the shopping centre/insurer is already disputing responsibility.

3. **Shine Lawyers Melbourne** — **strong specialist alternative**
   - Specifically handles Victorian slip/trip/fall claims and says it can investigate the incident, seek **CCTV footage**, obtain medical reports and deal with insurers.
   - Offers an obligation-free appointment and no-win-no-fee basis, subject to conditions. [www.shine.com.au](https://www.shine.com.au/resources/public-liability/slip-trip-falls-victoria?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

4. **LHD Lawyers Melbourne** — **worth getting a comparison quote/opinion**
   - Dedicated Melbourne public-liability practice covering slips and falls.
   - Advertises no-win-no-fee and has a strong local review profile. [www.lhd.com.au](https://www.lhd.com.au/office-location/vic/melbourne/public-liability-claims/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

5. **DCM Lawyers** — **smaller-firm option**
   - Very strong local review profile, although I'd ask specifically about the solicitor's recent shopping-centre/public-liability caseload before choosing them.

### What I'd do in your position

I'd get **2–3 free initial consultations**, probably starting with **Law Partners, Slater & Gordon and Shine**. Ask each lawyer:

- Have you handled **shopping-centre slip/fall cases against the centre/operator**?
- What evidence do you need from me?
- Will you immediately seek/preserve **CCTV and incident reports**?
- Who will actually run my case?
- What are **all costs if I lose**, including medical reports, barristers and the other side's costs?
- If I win, what will the **total legal costs come out of my settlement**?

That last question matters. In Victoria, **"no win, no fee" does not necessarily mean you pay nothing if you lose**. Disbursements and potentially the other side's costs can still arise, and an uplift fee may apply. The Victorian Legal Services Board says an uplift can be up to 25% of the lawyer's professional fees. [lsbc.vic.gov.au](https://lsbc.vic.gov.au/consumers/legal-costs-and-billing/no-win-no-fee-cost-agreements?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### One thing I'd do immediately

If the fall was recent, **don't wait for the lawyer before preserving evidence**. Keep photographs of the exact area, your injuries, clothing/shoes, receipts, medical records and the incident report. Most importantly, tell the centre **in writing** that you require them to preserve any CCTV covering the accident and surrounding area. CCTV can be overwritten relatively quickly.

There are also statutory time limits for Victorian public-liability claims; Shine currently states a general **three-year period**, although the precise limitation position depends on the circumstances. [www.shine.com.au](https://www.shine.com.au/resources/public-liability/slip-trip-falls-victoria?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you tell me **which Melbourne shopping centre you fell at, roughly when it happened, and what injury you suffered**, I can search specifically for lawyers who have handled cases against that centre/operator and give you a more targeted **top 3**, including current reviews and contact links.
